panels.title: Barrier bumps next to a barrier, by barrier reader
panels.description: Of the moves a creature made while standing next to a barrier, the share that walked into the barrier. Split by whether the creature's brain has a reachable node reading the barrier input (presence, not use). If creatures that can sense barriers bump as often as creatures that cannot, the sensor is not shaping their movement.

targets.expr: (sum by (petri_reader_state) (rate(petri_run_move_blocked_barrier_with_barrier_neighbor_by_reader_state_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[1m])) or 0 * sum by (petri_reader_state) (rate(petri_run_move_attempts_with_barrier_neighbor_by_reader_state_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[1m]))) / sum by (petri_reader_state) (rate(petri_run_move_attempts_with_barrier_neighbor_by_reader_state_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[1m]))

panels.title: Barrier bumps next to a barrier, run so far
panels.description: Of the moves a creature made while standing next to a barrier, the share that walked into the barrier. Split by whether the creature's brain has a reachable node reading the barrier input (presence, not use). If creatures that can sense barriers bump as often as creatures that cannot, the sensor is not shaping their movement. Totals since the run started.

targets.expr: (sum by (petri_reader_state) (last_over_time(petri_run_move_blocked_barrier_with_barrier_neighbor_by_reader_state_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (petri_reader_state) (last_over_time(petri_run_move_attempts_with_barrier_neighbor_by_reader_state_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[$__range]))) / sum by (petri_reader_state) (last_over_time(petri_run_move_attempts_with_barrier_neighbor_by_reader_state_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Barrier bumps next to a barrier, by tick
panels.description: The run-so-far bars over time: of the moves a creature made while standing next to a barrier, the share that walked into the barrier (1m window), plotted against simulation tick. Split by whether the creature's brain has a reachable node reading the barrier input (presence, not use). A gap opening with barrier readers below non-readers means the sensor is shaping movement; overlapping lines mean it is not.

panels.title: Offspring per removed creature, by cognitive class
panels.description: Offspring spawned per creature, over creatures that have died or been removed so far (living creatures are not counted). Classes are an accounting precedence over carried structure (plasticity, then stateful node, then shared memory, then none), not an ability ranking.

panels.title: Lifespan of removed creatures, by cognitive class
panels.description: Age at removal in ticks, averaged over creatures that have died or been removed so far (living creatures are not counted). Classes are an accounting precedence over carried structure (plasticity, then stateful node, then shared memory, then none), not an ability ranking.

panels.title: Eat hit rate, by food type
panels.description: Of the typed Eat actions naming a food type, the share that found food. A low hit rate means creatures eat without checking what is under them.

targets.expr: (sum by (petri_food_type) (rate(petri_run_eat_actions_applied_by_type_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[1m])) or 0 * sum by (petri_food_type) (rate(petri_run_eat_actions_failed_by_type_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[1m]))) / ((sum by (petri_food_type) (rate(petri_run_eat_actions_applied_by_type_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[1m])) or 0 * sum by (petri_food_type) (rate(petri_run_eat_actions_failed_by_type_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[1m]))) + (sum by (petri_food_type) (rate(petri_run_eat_actions_failed_by_type_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[1m])) or 0 * sum by (petri_food_type) (rate(petri_run_eat_actions_applied_by_type_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[1m]))))

panels.title: Food eaten, by food type (rate)
panels.description: Eat actions that consumed food, per second, by the food type the action named. Shows what the population actually harvests.

panels.title: Blocked moves, share of all moves, by cause
panels.description: Of the move actions executed, the share that did not move the creature, by what blocked it: a barrier, another creature, or the world edge.

panels.title: Predation attempts, by result (rate)
panels.description: StealEnergy actions per second, by what happened: energy transferred, or rejected (for example no victim in the target cell).

panels.title: Parent age at birth (1m window)
panels.description: Age of the parent, in ticks, when each child was delivered (after any gestation), over births in the last minute. Quantiles are interpolated within histogram buckets (bounds 20, 22, 25, 30, 40, 50, 75, 100, 150, 200, 300, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000 ticks); a quantile above 5000 reads as 5000. "First birth" is the parent's first delivered child: age at first reproduction.

panels.title: Parent age at birth, run so far
panels.description: Births over the whole time range by the parent's age at delivery, in ticks; each bar is one bucket, labelled by its inclusive upper bound (+Inf holds ages above 5000).

panels.title: Mean parent age at birth, run so far, by birth order
panels.description: Mean age of the parent, in ticks, at delivery, over every birth in the time range: "first" is each parent's first delivered child (age at first reproduction), "later" every subsequent one.

panels.title: Drive carriers, share of population, by kind (sampled)
panels.description: Share of living creatures with at least one live path into a kind's drive sink (Drive Move, Drive Reproduce, Drive StealEnergy; T11.F30), from the drives-v1 census over reachable nodes at each snapshot. Founders start with no drive edges, so any rise is mutation-borne and kept by selection. Structure, not use: a carried drive may still lose to the bar.

panels.title: Direction fan-outs, share of population, by kind (sampled)
panels.description: Share of living creatures that wire one source into two or more of a kind's eight direction sinks: the per-direction duplication a single drive edge replaces. Founders carry Move and Reproduce fan-outs. Drive carriers rising while fan-outs fall is the shift T11.F30 aims at.

panels.title: Drive carriers by tick (sampled)
panels.description: The drive-carrier shares plotted against simulation tick, one series per kind, so runs at different speeds compare on the same axis.

panels.title: Weight changes per creature-tick, by kind
panels.description: Plasticity edge assignments whose stored weight differs from its prior value, per creature-tick over a 1m window: pure Hebbian (applied after every graph visit) and reward-modulated (three-factor, applied once per tick after actions). How much learning actually moves weights. Activity, not effect: every compute node of a visited mesh node learns whether or not it feeds a sink, and a moved weight need not change behaviour.

panels.title: Plasticity updates per creature-tick, by kind
panels.description: Plasticity edge assignments per creature-tick, changed or not: one per plastic edge on either surface per committed graph visit (Hebbian, so multi-pass ticks count more than once) or per initialized edge per tick (reward-modulated, counted even when the outcome signal is 0). Mixes how many creatures carry plasticity with how active each one is.

panels.title: Share of plasticity updates that change a weight, by kind
panels.description: Weight changes over updates, per kind, over a 1m window. A low share means most updates write the same value back: zero pre or post activity, a zero outcome signal, or a weight held at its clamp. Exact f32 inequality, so a delta rounded or clamped away is not a change.

panels.title: Plasticity per creature-tick, run so far
panels.description: The Hebbian and reward-modulated update and change counters over all creature-ticks of the run so far. Learning is free (T25.F02), so it has no energy flow.

panels.title: Weight changes per creature-tick by tick
panels.description: Weight changes per creature-tick plotted against simulation tick, one series per kind, so runs at different speeds compare on the same axis.

panels.title: Plasticity carriers, share of population (sampled)
panels.description: Share of living creatures with at least one plastic edge (compute input or sink) on a reachable Graph node, from the plasticity census at each snapshot. Founders carry none, so any rise is mutation-borne and kept by selection. Structure, not use: a carried edge learns only when its mesh node is visited.

panels.title: Mean drift per plastic edge, by surface (sampled)
panels.description: Mean |learned - genome weight| over reachable plastic edges, compute inputs and sink edges apart. An edge not yet initialized (its mesh node never visited, no inherited seed) adds 0. Darwinian drift is learning within one lifetime; a seeded Lamarckian edge starts from the parent's learned weight, so its drift also carries what ancestors learned.

panels.title: Plastic edges at their clamp, share by surface (sampled)
panels.description: Share of reachable plastic edges whose initialized learned weight sits at plus or minus the edge's weight_clamp (in [0.01, 10]), compute inputs and sink edges apart. A high share means learning saturates instead of tracking its inputs; T17 found Covariance with large inputs reaching its clamp in one tick.

panels.title: Plastic edges by rule (sampled)
panels.description: Reachable plastic edges (compute inputs and sink edges) in the living population, per rule: the mix of rules selection keeps.

panels.title: Plasticity carriers by tick (sampled)
panels.description: The plasticity-carrier share plotted against simulation tick, so runs at different speeds compare on the same axis.

panels.title: Tick traces
panels.description: One row per tick trace of the run: its start, duration, tick and sample policy. The span ID opens the trace.

panels.title: Creature windows
panels.description: One row per creature window or manual sample of the run: its sample index, creature, policy, ticks recorded, end reason and truncation. The span ID opens the trace, whose tick spans carry the hop, pass and action events.

targets.query: { span.petri.run_id = "$run_id" && name = "creature_window" } | select(span.petri.window, span.petri.creature_id, span.petri.sample_policy, span.petri.ticks_recorded, span.petri.end_reason, span.petri.truncated)

panels.title: Sensors declared, share of population, by world input (sampled)
panels.description: Share of living creatures whose reachable nodes list each world input key in their input references, wired or not. Cached at birth. Carried, not necessarily used.

panels.title: Sensors wired, share of population, by world input (sampled)
panels.description: Share of living creatures whose sensor census reaches each key: a live VM read, a wired graph edge or a ring projection on the live walk. Cached at birth. Structural: a zero-weight or never-routed wire still counts.

panels.title: Sensors read, share of population, by world input (sampled)
panels.description: Share of living creatures whose most recent mesh run resolved each key: an executed VM read, or a graph leaf or ring projection evaluated on a visited node. Can exceed wired: a VM read whose result is unused still executes, and a graph node evaluates its dead compute nodes. Read is not influence.
